_comment_work_source: DISPATCH GATE (owner ruling 2026-09-06): dispatchable = carries triaged AND not covered by an open PR/branch/worktree AND carries none of the skip_signals. Require ONLY triaged — review, loop, severity (user-facing/internal) and proposal DO NOT block (they are for other lanes/bookkeeping). Only needs-decision (the single owner-blocked label) and an explicit wontfix gate. claimed/in-progress mean another session already owns it. Oldest issue number first; skip-to-disjoint on file overlap.
_comment_governance: max_in_flight is 5 (the stored value below is authoritative; this comment said 3 until 2026-09-08, which was stale — the number was reconciled UPWARD to match running behaviour, deliberately not downward, so nothing about dispatch changed). NOT the 8 default and nowhere near the 25 subagent cap. NOTE: the conductor's live patrol context tops up toward 10, which is a THIRD value and an unratified override — the owner should rule on one number. The binding limit is this box, not the scheduler: each worker runs `bun install` in a fresh worktree plus `bun test` and `bun run build`, and 36+ of the owner's own worktrees already exist. Raise it only after watching `resource_status` stay `ample` through a full round.
_comment_review_fleet: The REVIEW lane is a second worker population, separate from the coding workers governed by max_in_flight. Review workers are REAL SESSIONS, not spawn_run subagents: a subagent shares the parent slot and dies when the parent turn ends, which is shorter than a review takes — an 8-wide spawn_run fan-out on 2026-09-06 posted zero verdicts for exactly this reason. PR-BOT.md section 0 still instructs a spawn_run fan-out and is therefore WRONG for conductor-driven review; use sections 1-4 and 6 as the reviewer procedure and ignore section 0.

review_fleet.brief_freshness: A reviewer slot is a LONG-LIVED session reused across many PRs, so it reads the brief ONCE at session creation and then works from that in-context copy forever — an edit to PR-BOT.md is INERT for every slot created before it. MEASURED 2026-09-06: PR-BOT.md was edited at 07:36:42 adding a required control-run line and a test-merge step; slots chat-110 (created 02:07) and chat-168/169/170 (created 05:30) kept emitting the OLD verdict template, and 7 consecutive post-edit verdicts (#272,#273,#275,#276,#277,#278,#279) carried neither new line. THEREFORE: every dispatch must instruct the reviewer to RE-READ the brief_file sections at the START of that PR's review, before any gate or mutation work — not to rely on what it read at creation. When the brief has changed since a slot's creation, say so in the dispatch and name what changed, or retire the slot so a fresh one seeds against the current file.
review_fleet.gate_policy: Run the four gates IN the PR's existing ../encore-bot-<n> worktree, which is already at the PR head with node_modules installed — no fresh worktree, no bun install. Confirm `git status --short` is clean and HEAD equals the PR head first; if the coding bot has it dirty, fall back to a private ../encore-rev-<n>. Never write in a bot worktree.
review_fleet.e2e_policy: Browser/CDP evidence ONLY for a rendered-surface PR. Everything else is reading and reasoning.

_comment_encore_overrides: Three places the generic conductor procedure is WRONG for this repo. Read these before dispatching anything.

encore_overrides.full_suite_is_cheap: The skill's 'targeted tests ONLY, never the full suite, bounded pytest -n' rule exists for slow pytest repos. Encore is not one: `bun test` runs 1351 tests in ~8s and the worker's pytest runs ~540 in ~5s. Workers MUST run the full gates every time — the four are `bun test` (repo root), `cd apps/worker && python3 -m pytest -q`, `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`. Do NOT emit BANNED lines for full-suite runs here; a full run is the correct behaviour and banning it would strip the only safety net.
encore_overrides.there_is_no_ci: CRITICAL. This repo has NO .github/ and no CI whatsoever, so the skill's 'babysit the PR to green' and 'collapse check-runs per lane' steps have nothing to read. There are no check runs, no reviewer bot lanes, and no `PR Readiness` status. The review lane is `pr-bot` (docs/loop/PR-BOT.md), a scheduled agent that posts a verdict comment and applies `review:approved` or `review:blocked`. Independent green verification therefore means: (1) the four gates pass on the PR's head SHA, re-run by the conductor itself, not taken on the worker's word; (2) `review:approved` present and `review:blocked` absent; (3) every blocking finding in pr-bot's comment answered; (4) PR MERGEABLE and one commit on a fresh base.
encore_overrides.file_overlap_gate: The generic dispatch check catches an existing PR, branch or worktree for the SAME item. It does not catch two DIFFERENT items whose fixes touch the same files — and that is the common case here, because several open issues land in `TvPlayer.svelte`, `settings.ts` and `packages/shared`. Before dispatching, read the candidate issue's named `path:line` sites and skip the item if any in-flight worker's branch already touches that file (`git diff --name-only main...<branch>`). Whoever merges first makes the other stale, and the loser's rebase eats the whole win.
encore_overrides.phase_ladder_still_applies: RETIRED 2026-09-07 — the P0-P4 phase labels no longer exist. Migration: phase:P1 -> user-facing, phase:P2 -> internal, phase:P4 -> owner-only (itself deleted 2026-09-07), HIGH-PRIORITY -> priority; phase:P0 and phase:P3 deleted (P0/P1 were complete with zero open, and dispatch had already moved to oldest-issue-first, so the ladder ordered nothing). What replaces it: severity is user-facing vs internal; a user-facing defect outranks all internal work regardless of arrival order; the blocking family (needs-owner, owner-only, needs-repro, needs-owner-verification, for-owner) collapsed into the single label needs-decision on 2026-09-07 — the label is a boolean gate and the ISSUE COMMENT carries what is actually needed, as a Decisions block; priority is the owner's queue-jump and agents must never apply it. See docs/loop/DEFECT-TAXONOMY.md §1.6.

_comment_merge_authority: The worker merges, and only when the conductor has verified all four conditions in `there_is_no_ci` above. `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch` — `--delete-branch` is required because the repo has delete_branch_on_merge=false, and `--auto` is unavailable because allow_auto_merge=false. main has NO branch protection, so nothing external will stop a bad merge: these gates are the entire safety system.
